ayat.ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayat.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

ayat.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ayat.en: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

ayat.ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayat.en: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

ayat.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
ayat.en: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

ayat.ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
ayat.en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

ayat.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayat.en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

ayat.ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
ayat.en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

ayat.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
ayat.en: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.

ayat.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
ayat.en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayat.en: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

ayat.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayat.en: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

ayat.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayat.en: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.

ayat.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayat.en: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

ayat.ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
ayat.en: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

ayat.ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
ayat.en: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
ayat.en: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

ayat.ar: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
ayat.en: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]

ayat.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayat.en: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

ayat.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
ayat.en: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

ayat.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
ayat.en: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.

ayat.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
ayat.en: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.

ayat.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
ayat.en: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

w.en: and We gave it to you to drink

ayat.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
ayat.en: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
ayat.en: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

ayat.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayat.en: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayat.en: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

ayat.ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayat.en: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

ayat.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayat.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

ayat.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
ayat.en: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

ayat.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayat.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

ayat.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
ayat.en: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.

ayat.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
ayat.en: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

ayat.ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayat.en: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

ayat.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
ayat.en: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it, for indeed, you are expelled.

ayat.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayat.en: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

ayat.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayat.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

ayat.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayat.en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

ayat.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayat.en: Until the Day of the time well-known."

ayat.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayat.en: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all

ayat.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayat.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

ayat.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
ayat.en: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

ayat.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
ayat.en: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

ayat.ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayat.en: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

w.en: (is) surely the promised place for them

ayat.ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
ayat.en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."

ayat.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayat.en: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,

ayat.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayat.en: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

ayat.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
ayat.en: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

ayat.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
ayat.en: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

ayat.ar: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayat.en: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

ayat.ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
ayat.en: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

ayat.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayat.en: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

ayat.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
ayat.en: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."

ayat.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
ayat.en: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

ayat.ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayat.en: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

w.en: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings

ayat.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
ayat.en: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

ayat.ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayat.en: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

ayat.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayat.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

ayat.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayat.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

ayat.ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayat.en: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

ayat.ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
ayat.en: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

ayat.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayat.en: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

ayat.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayat.en: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

ayat.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayat.en: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

ayat.ar: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
ayat.en: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

w.en: And we have come to you

ayat.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
ayat.en: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

ayat.ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayat.en: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

ayat.ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
ayat.en: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

ayat.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
ayat.en: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

ayat.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
ayat.en: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."

ayat.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayat.en: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

ayat.ar: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayat.en: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

ayat.ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayat.en: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

ayat.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
ayat.en: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

ayat.ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayat.en: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

ayat.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayat.en: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

ayat.ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
ayat.en: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.

ayat.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayat.en: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

ayat.ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
ayat.en: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,

ayat.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayat.en: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayat.en: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.

ayat.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayat.en: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

ayat.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayat.en: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

ayat.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayat.en: But the shriek seized them at early morning,

ayat.ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayat.en: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

ayat.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
ayat.en: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

ayat.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayat.en: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
ayat.en: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.

ayat.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayat.en: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.

ayat.ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayat.en: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

ayat.ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
ayat.en: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

ayat.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayat.en: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.

ayat.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayat.en: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

ayat.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayat.en: About what they used to do.

ayat.ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayat.en: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

ayat.ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
ayat.en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

ayat.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayat.en: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.

ayat.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayat.en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

ayat.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
ayat.en: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

ayat.ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayat.en: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
